notes.title: Sweetbriar, Verdantia
notes.content: Oakheart Online begins in Sweetbriar, a working village of gardens, forge, pasture, lake, craft yards and old grove roads. The current playable map includes a forest loop with respawning scavengers, the forgotten arch and a solo Hollowstone cave-raid rehearsal. The boundary bell, wardstones and black ash anchor the prologue. The tone is cozy fantasy with self-aware jokes.

notes.title: Current build and MMO scope
notes.content: UE 5.8 C++ single-player action RPG prototype. The title is Oakheart Online, the realm is Verdantia, and the starting region is Sweetbriar. The game has local saves, third-person combat, quests, activities, UI, a class creator and a title screen. Networked parties, server authority, matchmaking, shared loot and a persistent MMO world are future work.

notes.title: Prologue and encounters
notes.content: The player rescues Alder's three sheep, returns Torven's ward hammer, drives off three road-ward raiders, consults Istren and defeats the Thorn Warden before reporting back to Alder. Noll teaches pier fishing and Pell explains the waystone. The Hollowstone rehearsal is a separate repeatable solo raid primer with two rooms, crystal seals, a Sentinel boss and a claimable reward chest. The in-game tracker uses stages rather than formal quest titles.

notes.title: Warrior: playable first pass
notes.content: Warrior can be chosen in character creation. Its stamina, guard, 15 active techniques, four shared passives, level/attribute/skill points, draggable four-slot hotbar and level-10 Slayer/Bastion/Marshal paths are playable. Advanced modifiers, purchased path passives, capstones, party effects and dedicated technique animation sets remain unfinished. The browser Warrior planner is a separate full design reference.

notes.title: Magic Man: design only
notes.content: The level 1-20 Magic Man catalogue, interactive planner, icons and shareable PDF exist, but Magic Man cannot yet be chosen or played in Unreal. Its five foundation pocket tricks include Charcoal, Still Lit; Piece of Ice; Dirt From The Ground; Definitely Not Vodka; and Vial of Strange Powder. At level 10 it branches into Spell Tosser, Feelin GoodMan or Molecule Bender. Only Molecule Bender discovers real magic.

notes.title: Playable lifeskills
notes.content: Woodcutting, Mining, Herbalism, Cooking, Alchemy, Smithing, Combat footwork practice and pier Fishing are playable activities. Station work has authored clips, fitted tools, spatial cues, approach-to-work positioning, recipe costs, rewards, cooldowns and saved profession XP. Station rank displays as 1 + floor(profession XP / 40). Trading caravans and tavern Gambling/Liar's Dice are future designs.

notes.title: Current quality priorities
notes.content: Continue a human-reviewed combat animation pass: the blade-contact physics and three-swing combo work, but more natural, weighty authored motion and technique-specific clips are still needed. Correct the alchemy mortar/jug placement: the current mortar sits about 40 cm below the tabletop, and Cooking/Alchemy contact still needs final in-game visual review. Fix Alder/waystone nameplates overlapping a cottage in the west-lane render. Keep checking both body forms, wrists, shoulders, hands and apparel in motion.

notes.title: Village and asset audit
notes.content: Latest placed-level survey: 661 inventoried village actors, 250 major props, zero road intrusions, zero major prop overlaps and zero hidden road-collision intrusions. Nearest market stock is 361 cm from the waystone centre. Asset sweep loaded 914 assets across 1,849 actors with zero reported missing/placeholder issues. Route (612 samples), quest smoke, water (18 checks) and expansion (62 checks) passed; visual polish remains a separate review.

notes.title: Tools and pipeline status
notes.content: Blender and UE5 MCP configurations exist; live Unreal MCP tools require an open, connected editor. Game Development Studio, Build 3D Game Rooms and Unreal Editor Skills are installed. Oakheart's source models are FBX, so Game Development Studio's GLB validation/catalog and visual-debug adapter are not yet wired to this project. Cascadeur setup was cancelled; no Cascadeur app or Live Link integration was installed.

quests.name: A Small Favour
quests.goals: Meet Alder by the market garden. Rescue three sheep from the north pasture (0/3). Report the black ash to Alder. This dashboard title is a chapter label; the game tracks stages.

quests.name: Tools Of The Trade
quests.goals: Speak to Torven at the forge. Recover his ward hammer beside the old well. Return it to repair the bell fitting and unlock sword upgrades.

quests.name: A Proper Hero
quests.goals: Drive off three road-ward raiders (0/3). Consult Istren at the standing stones. Defeat the Thorn Warden at the ruined arch. Tell Alder the boundary holds.

quests.name: A Village Worth Saving
quests.goals: Prologue complete. Explore Sweetbriar, train skills, fish at the pier, grind respawning forest scavengers and practice the separate Hollowstone cave rehearsal.

tasks.title: Polish player combat animations
tasks.description: Author and visually review weighty sword swings, natural shoulders/elbows/wrists, reliable palm grip and dedicated technique clips on both body forms.

tasks.title: Fix alchemy prop placement
tasks.description: Raise the mortar and jug to their workbench surface, then complete Cooking/Alchemy in-game hand-contact review.

tasks.title: Repair village nameplate composition
tasks.description: Resolve Alder/waystone label overlap and cottage-wall projection in the west-lane camera.

tasks.title: Implement playable Magic Man
tasks.description: Convert the finished class catalogue and planner into creator selection, mana, skills, three level-10 paths and runtime effects.

tasks.title: Connect asset validation pipeline
tasks.description: Define FBX-to-GLB review exports and a project visual-debug adapter before using Game Development Studio for systematic asset comparisons.

tasks.title: Design networked MMO foundation
tasks.description: Plan server authority, parties, shared encounters, persistence and multiplayer testing separately from the current solo prototype.
